description: Detach a resource from an app: remove the environment variables it set and restart the app if it is running, so a running app loses them at once. The resource itself and its data are unchanged, and other apps that hold it keep it. Detaching a resource that is not attached changes nothing. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the app belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

resource.description: Required. The resource's name in the organization.

name: detach_resource
title: Detach a resource from an app
